mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id FROM visit v JOIN member m ON m.member_id = v.member_id AND m.is_active = TRUE JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} AND LOWER(p.language) = LOWER(m.locale) ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM visit v JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.place_group_id = (SELECT place_group_id FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit (member_id, place_id, created_at) SELECT origin.member_id, sibling.place_id, origin.created_at FROM visit origin JOIN place tapped ON tapped.place_id = origin.place_id JOIN place sibling ON sibling.place_group_id = tapped.place_group_id AND sibling.place_id <> origin.place_id WHERE origin.visit_id = #{visitId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit x WHERE x.member_id = origin.member_id AND x.place_id = sibling.place_id)
